name: Polluted Puffer
tooltip:
Polluted Puffer
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Anglin' Score:  points.

Catch Rank: Guppy

Description:
A quirky specimen of The Coiled Isle, the Polluted Puffer houses many hidden spines that only make themselves apparent when threatened. In such cases, the fish inflates its body jutting the spines outward.

Special:

 Cooking

This rare and tasty fish is an important ingredient in several Midnight Cooking recipes.

Areas you can find this fish:
- The Coiled Isle

Fishing Pools:
- Willow Sea
- Viscous Venom

Rates:
- This fish is exceedingly common in pools.
